scripts.build: bun run wasm:all && bun run typecheck && vite build
scripts.generate:textures: bun scripts/generate-textures.ts && bun scripts/optimize-textures.mjs && bun run generate:pickup-atlas
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p bots/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p directory/tsconfig.json
scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --exclude sloppy-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sloppy-render -p sloppy-web -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sloppy-web --features labs -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sloppy-web --no-default-features --features webgl -- -D warnings
scripts.check: bun run check:site && bun run check:rust-lint && bun run check:server && bun run test:rust
scripts.check:site: bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run lint
scripts.check:rust-lint: bun run rust:fmt && bun run rust:clippy
scripts.check:server: bun run server:build && bun run test
scripts.build:dev: bun run wasm:all && bun run wasm:labs && bun run typecheck && DEPLOY_BASE=/ vite build --config vite.dev.config.ts
scripts.deploy:dev: bun run check && bun run build:dev && bun scripts/deploy-dev.mjs
scripts.server:deploy-check: cargo fmt -p sloppy-core -p sloppy-server --check && cargo clippy --locked -p sloppy-core -p sloppy-server --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -p sloppy-core -p sloppy-server
scripts.server:deploy: bun run server:deploy-check && bun scripts/server.mjs deploy
scripts.server:publish: bun run server:deploy-check && bun scripts/server.mjs publish
